column1: # DPRO Health — shared catalog descriptions.  key<TAB>description
# One line per compound, shared across every vendor catalog.
#   - One sentence. Plain English. What it is, then what it's for.
#   - NEVER name the vendor. Write "Retatrutide. Triple agonist...",
#     Coded SKUs (MA-3RT, GLA-3 RT, RETA-3) all describe the compound itself.
#   - Lines without a TAB are ignored by build.py, so comments are safe here.

Injectable vitamin B12. Supports energy metabolism, red blood cell production and nerve function.
The three branched-chain amino acids in liquid form, used around training for recovery and muscle-protein signalling.
Carnitine to shuttle fat into the mitochondria, arginine as a nitric-oxide precursor for blood flow.

Energy and focus liquid blend.

Multi-ingredient liquid amino blend.
Injectable B12 for energy metabolism, red blood cell production and nerve health.

Adamax, 1032 variant.
Adamax, 984 variant.

GHK-Cu and methylene blue in a tallow base for topical application.
Lipophilic antioxidant that concentrates in the mitochondria to scavenge free radicals in brain tissue.
Curcumin derivative with far better absorption. Raises BDNF and targets the mitochondria; a leading anti-aging brain compound.
Alkaloid from corydalis. Analgesic and sedative, studied for pain and stimulant craving.
The only magnesium form that meaningfully raises magnesium inside the brain. Used for synapse density and sleep quality.
Semax and Selank together in a dissolving oral strip. Focus and drive paired with an anxiolytic.
At low doses, a mitochondrial electron carrier that improves cellular energy production. Also antimicrobial.
Racetam acting on NMDA and cholinergic channels. Studied for post-stroke apathy and mood.
Three nootropic peptides combined in a sublingual spray.
Liquid blend for cognitive support and mental clarity.
Glutamic acid derivative with anti-amnestic and neuroprotective effects.
Dipeptide nootropic roughly a thousand times stronger than piracetam by weight. Raises BDNF and NGF.
Grows new neurons in the hippocampus and increases its volume. An antidepressant mechanism that doesn't work through serotonin.
Synthetic version of a nerve growth factor. Promotes new brain cell growth without the side effects of the natural protein.
Blocks the TREK-1 channel, a fast-acting antidepressant mechanism that also encourages new neuron growth.
Strong anxiety relief and sociability via GABA-B. Tolerance builds fast and withdrawal is real, so strictly occasional use.
Phenylpiracetam variant that skews calming rather than stimulating, while keeping the memory benefits.
The original nootropic. Mild, broad support for memory and mental clarity.
Best documented for a dramatic improvement in verbal memory and word recall.
Anxiolytic peptide that calms without sedation or cognitive fog, while supporting memory via BDNF.
Selank paired with DSIP in a spray, combining daytime calm with sleep support.
Raises BDNF and nerve growth factor. Used for focus, mental stamina and neuroprotection.
The classic stack: Semax for drive and focus, Selank to take the edge off.
Extremely potent ampakine active at microgram doses. Memory and learning.
Selective AMPA receptor potentiator without the seizure risk of older ampakines. Fast antidepressant signal.
Blocks the NNMT enzyme, which raises cellular NAD+ and shifts fat cells toward burning rather than storing.

Modified fragment of growth hormone that targets fat burning only, without affecting blood sugar or IGF-1.
Pan-AMPK activator. Improves insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake, mimicking part of what exercise does.
Mitochondrial uncoupler. Raises calorie burn by releasing energy as heat rather than storing it.

Potent stimulant. Sharp energy and appetite suppression, with a strong effect on blood pressure.

Lipotropic fat-metabolism blend with added B12 for energy.
Higher-strength lipotropic blend for fat metabolism and liver support.

Mitochondrial peptide that activates AMPK. Improves insulin sensitivity and metabolic flexibility; an exercise mimetic.
Liquid blend formulated for fat-loss support.
Exercise mimetic that activates ERR-alpha, raising fat oxidation and mitochondrial production in muscle.
SLU-PP-332 with BAM15, pairing an exercise mimetic with a mitochondrial uncoupler.
Next-generation SLU-PP compound hitting all three ERR receptors for broader metabolic activation.
Blocks reuptake of dopamine, noradrenaline and serotonin. Strong appetite suppression, in capsule form.
Triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor used for strong appetite suppression. Not a GLP-1.

The most powerful GHRP by peak GH release, but it desensitises fastest. Short cycles only.
Maximum-amplitude growth hormone pulse. Powerful but desensitises quickly.
Modified IGF-1 that stays active far longer in the body. Muscle growth and recovery.
The cleanest growth hormone secretagogue. Raises GH with essentially no cortisol, prolactin or hunger spike.
The most popular growth hormone combination, run before bed for sleep quality and recovery.
The standard GH pairing in a dissolving oral strip, no injection required.
Oral growth hormone secretagogue. Raises GH and IGF-1 around the clock; expect hunger and water retention.
Newer orally active growth hormone secretagogue in the MK series. Limited public data.
The original GHRH fragment. Very short-acting and mild, producing a natural GH pulse pattern.
The only GH secretagogue with clinical data specifically on reducing visceral belly fat.
Visceral-fat-targeted GHRH paired with the cleanest GHRP. A popular body-recomposition combination.
Cagrilintide. Long-acting amylin analog that drives fullness; often stacked with a GLP-1.
Long-acting amylin analog. Slows stomach emptying and increases fullness, usually run alongside a GLP-1.
Cagrilintide and semaglutide together, hitting the amylin and GLP-1 pathways at the same time.
Semaglutide. Weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist.
Tirzepatide. Dual GIP and GLP-1 agonist, taken weekly.
Tirzepatide and retatrutide combined in one vial.
Retatrutide. Triple agonist hitting GLP-1, GIP and glucagon.

Semaglutide. Single GLP-1 receptor agonist, taken weekly.
Tirzepatide. Dual GIP and GLP-1 agonist, generally stronger than semaglutide for weight loss.
Retatrutide. Triple agonist on GLP-1, GIP and glucagon, with the largest weight loss of the class in trials.
Retatrutide with cagrilintide in one vial, adding amylin to the triple agonist.

Dual GLP-1 and glucagon agonist. The glucagon arm adds calorie burn on top of appetite suppression.

Retatrutide. Triple agonist on GLP-1, GIP and glucagon.
Semaglutide. Weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist.
Survodutide. Dual GLP-1 and glucagon agonist.

Tirzepatide. Dual GIP and GLP-1 agonist, taken weekly.
Non-blood-building EPO derivative. Targets nerve repair and neuropathic pain, especially small-fibre nerve damage.
The backbone of injury recovery. Drives blood vessel growth and fibroblast migration for tendon, ligament, muscle and gut-lining repair.
BPC-157 with KPV in capsule form, aimed at gut lining repair and inflammation.
The default injury stack: BPC-157 for local tissue repair, TB-500 for whole-body cell migration.
Arginine salt of BPC-157, noticeably more stable than the standard form, with added nitric oxide support.
Cartilage bioregulator peptide. Targets chondrocyte function and joint tissue.
Cartalax layered onto BPC-157, TB-500 and KPV. A joint-focused version of the KLOW repair stack.
A proprietary repair blend. Exact composition isn't published.
GHK-Cu, TB-500 and BPC-157 together. The go-to stack for skin, hair and connective tissue.
GLOW with KPV added for the anti-inflammatory and gut arm. A four-peptide repair matrix.
KPV, TB-500 and BPC-157 together for tissue repair plus inflammation control.
Naturally occurring fatty acid amide. Non-opioid pain relief and anti-inflammatory action, particularly for nerve pain.
The full name for BPC-157, a fifteen-amino-acid peptide for tissue and gut repair.
KPV, TB-500 and BPC-157 repair blend in tablet form.
Actin-regulating peptide that drives cell migration and blood vessel growth throughout the body. The systemic partner to BPC-157.
The Wolverine stack. TB-500 and BPC-157 together for injury recovery.
BPC-157 in a topical form applied directly over the injured area.
Copper peptide repair paired with KPV's anti-inflammatory action.
The body's master antioxidant, injected. Used for detox pathways, liver support and skin brightening.
The active tail of alpha-MSH. A potent anti-inflammatory, and the first choice for gut inflammation.
Human antimicrobial defence peptide. Broad antibacterial activity plus biofilm disruption and immune modulation.
Acetylated glutathione that survives digestion and reaches the cell intact. Oral master antioxidant.
Thymus extract. The immune preparation behind the famous Russian longevity trials.
Thymic dipeptide. An immune regulator, and a registered prescription drug in Russia at microgram doses.
Thymic peptide that matures and directs T-cells. Immune restoration rather than blanket stimulation.
Thymus bioregulator dipeptide. Immune support and gene reactivation in aged cells.

Lung and bronchial bioregulator peptide.
Heart muscle bioregulator peptide.

Mitochondrial electron carrier and fat-soluble antioxidant. Heart and cellular energy support.
Brain cortex bioregulator peptide.

Senolytic peptide. Targets worn-out senescent cells and prompts them to clear themselves out.
Shifts haemoglobin to release more oxygen into tissue. Endurance research.
Liver bioregulator peptide. Also loosens packed-up DNA in aged immune cells.
NAD+ in a dissolving oral strip, avoiding the flush that comes with injecting it.

NAD+ paired with carnitine, combining cellular energy with fat transport.
pH-buffered NAD+, formulated to reduce injection-site discomfort.

PPAR-delta agonist. Dramatic endurance gains and fat oxidation; carries rodent cancer data at very high doses.
Second-generation ligandrol with a more tissue-selective profile and notable bone density data.

Ester-modified RAD-140 that stays active longer in the body.

Melanotan 2 in a dissolving oral strip, no injection needed.
Tadalafil analog working through the same PDE5 mechanism.
Bioregulator sold for ovarian and liver support, though the published research describes kidney function.
The bonding hormone. Social connection, trust and orgasmic response.
Prostate bioregulator peptide.

Bioregulator sold for testicular support, though there is almost no published research behind that use.

Copper peptide focused on hair growth and follicle stimulation.
The flagship skin peptide. Copper-binding tripeptide driving collagen production, wound healing and hair follicle signalling.
Topical serum for skin tone and brightening.
Topical peptide that softens expression lines by reducing muscle contraction at the surface.
Delta sleep-inducing peptide. Promotes deep slow-wave sleep and dampens the stress axis.
Liquid melatonin blend for sleep onset and circadian timing.
Sleep blend in a dissolving oral strip.
Liquid blend formulated for sleep support.
Orexin receptor blocker. A newer sleep mechanism that works by switching off wakefulness rather than sedating you.
